run_train_simmc_agent: run the SIMMC agent training script with command line arguments for data paths and model options
create_dataloader_simmc: create a SIMMC dataloader instance with train or eval data path and retrieval candidate settings
build_assistant_model: build a SIMMC assistant model with configurable encoder type and hyperparameters
evaluate_simmc_agent: evaluate a trained SIMMC agent on validation data and compute action prediction metrics
save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with state dict, arguments, and best epoch info
